Let lambda1 be the lowest eigenvalue of -Delta on H0^1(Omega_L). Survey published numerical values versus certified enclosures for lambda1 on triangles/quadrilaterals/L-shapes, then prove a new rigorous two-sided enclosure [L,U] with L <= lambda1 <= U, width U-L <= 5e-4, via P2-conforming FEM Rayleigh-quotient upper bound plus Lehmann-Goerisch lower bound with explicit a posteriori majorant, all linear-algebra and quadrature steps interval-verified, with meshes, stiffness/mass matrices and bound scripts stored and rerunnable in <10 minutes.
